name: Terasaki Electric Co.,Ltd.
summary: Terasaki Electric Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells marine and industrial systems, circuit breakers, and medical devices in Japan, Asia, and Europe. The company offers power distribution systems, control and monitoring systems, medical equipment, energy-saving and environment-friendly systems, crew education and training systems, onboard data platforms, and marine computers; industrial power distribution control and cogeneration systems; circuit breakers, such as moulded cases, air, multi-cable transit, and other products; and develops, designs, and manufactures medical equipment and clinical testing equipment.
